title: Into the Chu Yun Empire
summary: Grand Commander Kui Xing fights Zi Yan, and Medusa stops it and sends him to the snake cave for a month. Medusa insists on coming, so Xiao Yan, Medusa and Zi Yan travel to Sky Poison City, the Poison Sect's headquarters. Little Fairy Doctor tells them a Hall of Souls member pressed her to capture Xiao Yan, and she traced him to the Ten Thousand Scorpion Gate. At the Sky Scorpion Mountain Range, Elder Wu doubts the three Dou Huang guests, and the elders suspect a spy because the enemy always knows their moves. Little Fairy Doctor closes the camp and attacks anyway, but walks into an ambush and Xie Shan's Poison Cloud Formation. She breaks it, and the Gate's old master Xie Biyan, a peak four-star Dou Zong, comes out to fight her.
